★ FOLLOWED ARTIST — Dead Men Strumming (Dan Weintraub & Corey Unger), standing Friday residency, 5-8 PM every Friday at River Roost Brewery, per deadmenstrumming.net (site states "Playing EVERY FRIDAY NIGHT").
Genre: Grateful Dead — top taste priority
Price: Free (brewery, no cover)
~75 min from the Burlington area (Edge/marginal)
Note: on confirmed dates Sept 12, Oct 25 & Nov 14 they play Shelburne Vineyard instead (separate book-ahead holds created); Oct 17 & Nov 21 they play Public House in Quechee instead. This recurring hold may occasionally land on a Friday they're actually elsewhere — treat as "DMS is likely playing somewhere nearby" reminder and check deadmenstrumming.net.
Source: deadmenstrumming.net (authoritative tour schedule, fetched 2026-08-24)
